# Character enrichment sources

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:

  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.

  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 召# (curve) + 心 heart/emotions → *sadness*; *sorrow* (← warped emotions; compare the aspect of warped emotions in 忉 and in 怨).
悲也。从心召聲。
怓也。从心民聲。
As per 乍# (create a pile) + 心 heart/emotions → cumulative, negative emotions (compare 惜 and 惻) → *be ashamed*.
慙也。从心，作省聲。
As per 央# (stretch) + 心 heart/emotions → *dissatisfaction* (← emotional stretching/torture; compare 殃) → *grudge*.
不服，懟也。从心央聲。
As per 奴# (strenuous activity) + 心 heart/emotions → strenuous emotion, in the form of *anger*.
恚也。从心奴聲。
亂也。从心奴聲。《詩》曰：“以謹惽怓。”
白# white + 心 heart/emotions → *be afraid* (← go pale with fear; compare 怖) → *worry*; *be apprehensive*.
無爲也。从心白聲。
As per 布# (spread) + 心 heart/emotions → fear spreading over the heart → *frightened*; *afraid*. Compare 恐.
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 心 heart/emotions → fixed emotions in the form of tranquility → *peaceful*. Also, *submissive* (← follow with a tranquil heart).
古# old + 心 heart/emotions → something old on which one can *rely/depend* → *parent*.
恃也。从心古聲。
驕也。从心且聲。
As per 旦# (long and flat) + 心 heart/emotions → emotions figuratively flattened by nervousness or worry → *nervous*; *worried*.
憯也。从心旦聲。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 心 heart/emotions → heart long-suffering on account of pity/sympathy → *sympathize* (compare 憐). *Intelligence* and *cleverness* are borrowed meanings.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows that the top element was originally not 田 field but a depiction of a profusion of fine bones in fontanels, open spaces in an infant's skull over which the skull bones eventually fuse; compare 兒. 思 adds 心 heart/emotions → finely detailed thoughts → *think*; *consider*; *believe* → *be sunk in thought*. Compare 慮.
容也。从心囟聲。凡思之屬皆从思。
朗也。从心由聲。《詩》曰：“憂心且怞。”
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 心 heart/emotions → respond to pressure by becoming lazy/idle etc. → *be lazy*; *be idle*; *neglect*; *be inattentive*; *skip* (class/work etc.).
慢也。从心台聲。
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 心 heart/emotions → profound joy → *rejoice*.
和也。从心台聲。
思也。从心付聲。

The relevant seal inscription form shows 急 to have originally consisted of 及# (press on) + 心 heart/emotions → feelings of being pressed upon → *rush*; *hurry*; *hasten* → *sudden*; *emergency*; *steep*.
褊也。从心及聲。
生# birth; life + 心 heart/emotions → one's inborn nature → *character*; *nature*; *sex*; *gender* → *essence*.
人之陽气性善者也。从心生聲。
An abbreviated form# of 宛 bend + 心 heart/emotions → bent, warped emotions → *enmity*; *hatred*; *grudge*. Compare 慍.
恚也。从心夗聲。
As per 尼# (close contact) + 心 heart/emotions → *timidity/bashfulness* caused by overly close contact (compare 昵) → *be ashamed*.
衂怩，慙也。从心尼聲。

圣# is 又 hand/action indicator + 土 earth → knead a lump of earth/clay (compare 塊 and 顆). 怪 adds 心 heart/emotions → *odd* feelings aroused by the figure of a lumpy, mysterious object (compare 鬼) → *mystery*; *wonder*; *doubt*; *suspicion*; *strange*; *dubious*.
異也。从心圣聲。
As per 弗# (split) + 心 heart/emotions → heart split on account of anxiety → *depression*; *rage* (← other manifestations of an unbalanced heart).
鬱也。从心弗聲。
憂皃。从心幼聲。
去# withdraw + 心 heart/emotions → *shrink from* in fear → *be fearful*; *cowardice*.
As per 匆# (compression) + 心 heart/emotions → compress time in rushing about (compare 速 and 趣) → *be flustered*; *in a rush/hurry*; *do in haste*.
憂也。从心丙聲。《詩》曰：“憂心怲怲。”
狂之皃。从心，況省聲。
As per 朮# (pass through) + 心 heart/emotions → wave of *fear* passing through the heart → *apprehensive*.
恐也。从心术聲。
永 long time + 心 heart/emotions → *endure*.
As per 任# (encompass) + 心 heart/emotions → consider (← encompass in the heart; compare 念). *This*, *this kind of* and *thus* are borrowed meanings.
下齎也。从心任聲。
As per 旬# (cycle/circle → perfect circle) + 心 heart/emotions → perfect attentiveness → *attentive*; *sincere*; *careful*.
信心也。从心旬聲。
As per 寺# (stand straight by) + 心 heart/emotions → assume an attitude of inaction, relying/depending on others to take the lead → *rely/depend on*.
賴也。从心寺聲。

As per 亙# (moon crossing the evening sky → fixed phenomenon) + 心 heart/emotions → constancy likened to that of the moon crossing the sky every evening → *constantly*; *always*; *fixed* → *habitual* (← always).
As per 匡# (extend within a framing object) + 心 heart/emotions → *fear* extending throughout the heart. Compare 惶.
怯也。从心、匡，匡亦聲。
意也。从心旨聲。
同心之和。从劦从心。
As per 光# (light extending from a torch) + 心 heart/emotions → *absent-minded*; *enraptured* (as though dazzled by light). Also, *dim/hazy*.

The relevant seal inscription form of 巩 is 工 (connecting pipe/tube) + an element combining 卩 kneeling figure with arms extended (seen also in 埶) and 手 hand/action indicator → kneel and pierce a hole in connecting two objects with a pipe/tube → secure/fasten. 恐 is 巩# + 心 heart/emotions → empty/uneasy feeling in one's heart (compare 匈), as though a hole has been pierced in it → *fear* → *threaten*; *fearsome*; *awe*; *dread* → *apprehension*; *concern* → *terrible*; *horrible*; *fierce*; *tremendous* (← aspects of a threatening or fearsome object). *Probably* and *possibly* are via the uncertainty of the state of mind that fears something desired may not in fact materialize.
懼也。从心𢀜聲。
變也。从心危聲。
常也。从心从舟，在二之閒上下。心以舟施，恆也。

交 here an abbreviated form# of 姣 (woman standing in an alluring posture) + 心 heart/emotions → *agreeable sensation* produced by an attractive woman. *Clever* and *cunning/sly* are borrowed meanings, via 狡.
憭也。从心交聲。
As per 如# (supple) + 心 heart/emotions → supple/pliant attitude of tolerance or forgiveness → *tolerate*; *forgive*; *excuse* (← follow a suggestion to demonstrate magnanimity) → *thoughtfulness*.
仁也。从心如聲。
羊 here an abbreviated form# of 痒 itchy + 心 heart/emotions → worry (← a form of emotional itchiness) → *illness* (particularly, one characterized by itchiness).
憂也。从心羊聲。
As per 圭# (cone-shaped) + 心 heart/emotions → *be/get angry* (← an emotional state that is pointy rather than round/harmonious).
恨也。从心圭聲。
As per 匈# (cavity of the breast) + 心 heart/emotions → *fear*(← emptying/debilitating emotion; compare 恐).

Originally, an abbreviated form# of 宜 (pile) + 灰 ash → *great* pile of ash → *vast*. Also, *empty* (← emptiness created by a conflagration resulting in a great pile of ash). The present form substitutes 心 heart/emotions for the abbreviated form of 宜.
大也。从心灰聲。
心 heart/emotions + 次 here an abbreviated form# of 姿 (preoccupied) → *self-preoccupation*; *selfish* → *arbitrary*.
縱也。从心次聲。

As per 血# (be filled) + 心 heart/emotions → heart filled with commiseration → *show consideration for (be anxious about) the plight of another*; *materially relieve one in distress*. For the idea of commiserating with or comforting a suffering person, compare 慰.
憂也。收也。从心血聲。
As per 耳# (supple) + 心 heart/emotions → *shame*; *ashamed*; *embarrassed*; *shy*; *bashful* (← soft/weak/timid heart) → *disgrace*.
辱也。从心耳聲。
慙也。从心而聲。

As per 艮# (adhere) + 心 heart/emotions → *resentfulness*; *hold a grudge* (← negative feelings adhering to the heart) → *blame*; *reproach*; *be bitter*; *hate* → *regret*; *repent* (← regret/repent of one's resentfulness).
怨也。从心艮聲。
As per 因# (superimpose) + 心 heart/emotions → feelings of *gratitude* that superimpose themselves on the heart and adhere → *favor*. Compare 懇.
惠也。从心因聲。
As per 各# (hard) + 心 heart/emotions → unwavering (= hard/firm) *respect* → *reverent attitude*.
As per 同# (run through) + 心 heart/emotions → *fear*/*distress* (← emotions running through the body) → *threaten* (causing fear/distress).
痛也。一曰呻吟也。从心同聲。
舌 here an abbreviated form# of 甜 sweet + 心 heart/emotions → *calm*; *composure*; *tranquility* (← sweet state of being).
安也。从心，甛省聲。
As per 共# (act jointly in making an offering) + 心 heart/emotions → *deferential*; *reverential*; *respectful* (← ceremonious emotions experienced when offering an object to one's superior).
肅也。从心共聲。
謹也。从心全聲。

As per 自# (nose) + 心 heart/emotions → breathe through the nostrils in rhythm with the beating of the heart → *breath* → *live* → *give birth*; *increase*. Also, *stop*; *rest* (← stops and starts of steady breathing); *interest* (← increase); *son* (← give birth).
喘也。从心从自，自亦聲。

As per 合# (press/fit together) + 心 heart/emotions → *fit* one's heart; *match* one's ideas → *precisely*; *just (as)*; *as though*. The pronunciation カッ in compounds derives from カフ, an old Japanese pronunciation of this character.
用心也。从心合聲。

噁.explanation: The nausea/queasiness sense rather than moral evil.
噁.evidenceScope: OpenCC 1.4.2 explicitly maps 恶心→噁心; other pronunciations of 恶 need context.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

惡.explanation: Bad, evil, wicked sense rather than nausea.
惡.evidenceScope: OpenCC 1.4.2 explicitly maps 恶劣→惡劣.

entries.text: As per 肙# as described in 絹 (reel/unwind) + 心 heart/emotions → *irritable* (← unwound emotions).
忿也。从心肙聲。一曰憂也。
愊也。从心困聲。
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 心 heart/emotions → shriveled emotions, in the form of sadness or *depression* → *quiet*; *silent*.
憂也。从心肖聲。《詩》曰：“憂心悄悄。”
忘也。嘾也。从心余聲。《周書》曰：“有疾不悆。”悆，喜也。
飾也。从心戒聲。《司馬法》曰：“有虞氏悈於中國。”
As per 心# (heart of an object) + 釆 scattered seeds (→ small bits → details) → *know* something completely (figuratively, to its deepest heart) → *all*; *altogether*; *completely*; *entirely*.
詳盡也。从心从釆。
敬也。从心折聲。
吝# stingy + 心 heart/emotions (for emphasis/clarification) → *stingy* → *overly particular about*.

As per 弟# (vertical alignment) + 心 heart/emotions → deference shown to elders by those younger → *defer to/serve one's elders*. Taking 弟 in its developed sense of "younger brother," 悌 also indicates *harmonious fraternal relations*.
善兄弟也。从心弟聲。經典通用弟。
旱# dry up (→ be/become rough) + 心 heart/emotions → *rough*; *brutish* → *courageous*. Also, *strong*.
勇也。从心旱聲。
惶也。从心甫聲。
As per 邑# (press) + 心 heart/emotions → *be depressed*; *have a heavy heart* (← negative emotions pressing on the heart).
不安也。从心邑聲。
As per 毎# (dark) + 心 heart/emotions → dark emotions, in the form of *regret* or *vexation* → *repent*; *mourn* → *mortifying*; *condolences*.
悔恨也。从心𣫭聲。
孛# spring up + 心 heart/emotions → spring up in opposition (emotionally) → *be contrary/contradictory*. Also, *be in disorder*.
免 here an abbreviated form# of 晩 night + 心 heart/emotions → heart shrouded in darkness, in the form of being at a loss or in a daze (compare 惛) → *be at a loss*; *be in a daze*.
As per 束# (compact) + 心 heart/emotions → shrink in *fear* or *dread*. Compare 竦 and 糉.
As per 夋# as described in 俊 (stand erect) + 心 heart/emotions → stand erect in a formal display of repentance → *repent*.
止也。从心夋聲。
As per 里# (long strip) + 心 heart/emotions → long-lasting *anxiety* or *regret*. The reading カイ, used primarily in names, is a borrowed one.
啁也。从心里聲。《春秋傳》有孔悝。一曰病也。
As per 吾# (crossing) + 心 heart/emotions → crossing point between ignorance and *understanding*, *enlightenment* or *comprehension* (compare 晤) → *perception*; *realization*; *notice*.
覺也。从心吾聲。
As per 攸# (distant) + 心 heart/emotions → emotional distance → *distant*. *Leisure* is a borrowed meaning.
憂也。从心攸聲。
串# pierce + 心 heart/emotions → *worry*; *suffer* (← heart that is figuratively pierced) → (be) *ill*; *trouble*.
憂也。从心上貫吅，吅亦聲。
多遽悤悤也。从心、囪，囪亦聲。
As per 兌# (strip away) + 心 heart/emotions → strip away unpleasant feelings → *pleasure*; *joy*.
利# sharp + 心 heart/emotions → *clever*; *smart* (← excellent at making sharp distinctions). Compare 俐 and 怜.
樂也。从心宗聲。

As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 心 heart/emotions → heart that loses its harmony by being divided → *irritation* (often, with specific reference to inability to speak/express oneself). Compare and contrast 悲.
口悱悱也。从心非聲。

As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 心 heart/emotions → heart split by *sadness* or lamentation → *lament*; *grieve* → *mercy* (← strive to eliminate the sadness of common people). Compare and contrast 悱.
痛也。从心非聲。
外得於人，内得於己也。从直从心。
As per 卒# (compact) + 心 heart/emotions → physical and emotional paucity → *emaciation* (compare 瘁). *(My) son* is a borrowed meaning; compare 倅.
憂也。从心卒聲。讀與《易》萃卦同。
長# long + 心 heart/emotions → long-lasting feelings of sadness/lamentation → *lament*; *be sad*; *be disappointed*.
望恨也。从心長聲。
As per 門# (concealed) + 心 heart/emotions → gloomy, depressed feelings concealed in the heart → *anguish/agony* (caused by melancholy). Compare 懣.
懣也。从心門聲。
As per 季# (regular cycle) + 心 heart/emotions → *throb* (← regular pulsation) → *fear* (← throb/shake with fear).
心動也。从心季聲。
憂也。从心官聲。
As per 卓# (rise above) + 心 heart/emotions → feelings of grief/lamentation that rise above (= overcome) the heart → *grieve*; *lament*; *mourn*.
懼也。陳楚謂懼曰悼。从心卓聲。
妻 here an abbreviated form# of 淒 (chilling) + 心 heart/emotions → *sorrowful*; *mournful*.
痛也。从心妻聲。
欲知之皃。从心侖聲。
憂困也。从心臽聲。
飢餓也。一曰憂也。从心叔聲。《詩》曰：“惄如朝飢。”

As per 青# (clean/pure) + 心 heart/emotions → pure emotion, in the form of *compassion*, *sympathy*, *pity* or *charity* → *truth*; *circumstances* (← true feelings expressing a situation exactly as it is).
人之陰气有欲者。从心青聲。
周 here an abbreviated form# of 凋 droop + 心 heart/emotions → *be disappointed/dejected* (← drooping emotions).
失意也。从心周聲。

The element# now written 享 originally combined 羊 here an abbreviated form of 群 swarm + a depiction of a wall → swarm within an enclosure. 惇 adds 心 heart/emotions → *considerate*; *sincere* (← inclusive emotions swarming over the breast).
厚也。从心𦎫聲。
惉懘，煩聲也。从心沾聲。
宛# bend + 心 heart/emotions → heart figuratively bent with *regret*. Compare 怨.
毒也。从心其聲。《周書》曰：“來就惎惎。”
As per 林# (encompass) + 心 heart/emotions → heart encompassed with *insatiable greed*. Also, *cold-hearted* (← greedy and indifferent to others; compare 冷).
河内之北謂貪曰惏。从心林聲。
As per 或# (enclosure) + 心 heart/emotions → feelings of being circumscribed → *perplexity* (← be at a loss how to escape confinement) → *mislead*; *go astray* (← cause/result of perplexity).
亂也。从心或聲。
卷# curl + 心 heart/emotions → figuratively assume a curled position in fatigue (compare 倦) → *be physically/emotionally fatigued*.
憂也。从心炎聲。《詩》曰：“憂心如惔。”
As per 易# (stretch flat) + 心 heart/emotions → flattened emotions, in the form of *fear*, *dread* or anxiety → *be anxious*. Compare 惵.
敬也。从心易聲。
罔# obscure + 心 heart/emotions → *lose heart* (← lose sight of one's aim/desire) → *grow vague*.
叕# connect + 心 heart/emotions → *anxious/worried* (← be distressed over one thing after another).
憂也。从心叕聲。《詩》曰：“憂心惙惙。”一曰意不定也。

As per 忽# absent-minded + 心 heart/emotions → *absent-minded* → *be/become senile*; *vague*. Also, *fall in love* and *be/become enraptured*. 惚 was devised to convey the sense of "absent-minded" after 忽 underwent its transformation of meanings.
As per 昏# (darkness) + 心 heart/emotions → heart shrouded in darkness, in the form of *confusion* or dull-mindedness (compare 悗) → *dull-minded*; *stupid*.
不憭也。从心昬聲。

As per 昔# (pile) + 心 heart/emotions → negative feelings piled in the heart, in the form of *regret*, *disappointment*, lamentation etc. → *lament*; *reluctant* → (reluctant to) *spare/grudge*. Also, *cherish*, *hold/regard dear*, and *precious* (← be loathe to part with), as well as *pitiful* (← lament) and *wasteful* (← sparing/grudging).
痛也。从心㫺聲。
As per 隹# (exert downward pressure) + 心 heart/emotions → force another to *ponder*/*think deeply*. *This* (*only*) is a borrowed meaning, via 唯.
凡思也。从心隹聲。

A variant form of 褱 as described in 懷 (fall and be absorbed), indicating a *benefaction* from above, whether actually (rain for crops) or figuratively (a *blessing*) → *bless*; *have mercy on*; *benevolence*; *kindness*; *warmth* → *bestow*; *favor*. *Calm* is an extended meaning, while *smart* is a borrowed meaning. For "benefaction," compare 恤.
仁也。从心从叀。

As per 亞# (downward pressure) + 心 heart/emotions → hatred/resentment induced by being pressured → *evil*; *wicked*; *bad*; *hatred* → *wrong* (← bad attitude, answer etc.). There is a possibility that the graphically similar 𢛳 (one's true nature) described in 德 has influenced the meanings of 惡 in a reverse, negative sense.
過也。从心亞聲。
心疑也。从三心。凡惢之屬皆从惢。讀若《易》“旅瑣瑣”。

Originally, 怱# (compression) + 手 hand/action indicator → compress in unifying → *all*; *overall*. Compare 總. The present form, replacing 手 with 牛, was no doubt created under the influence of the unrelated character 物.
懼 is as per 瞿# (look nervously about) + 心 heart/emotions → nervous emotion in the forms of *fear*, *awe* or *apprehensiveness*. 惧 is a variant form of 懼.
An abbreviated form# of 隋 (collapsing pile) + 心 heart/emotions → *laziness* (likened to partial emotional collapse). Compare 怠.

The relevant seal inscription form of 𡿺# shows hair curling over a scalp, with the form 𡿺 transforming the element into a cranium with three bending lines suggesting wrinkles in the soft brains. 惱 adds 心 heart/emotions → persistent thoughts (compare 願 and 慮) of a disturbing nature running about the brain → *distress*; *trouble*; *affliction*; *worry* → *harass*.
重厚也。从心軍聲。
相# mutual + 心 heart/emotions → thoughts one harbors with respect to an object → *thought*; *idea*.
冀思也。从心相聲。
憂懼也。从心耑聲。《詩》曰：“惴惴其慄。”
As per 枼# as described in 葉 (thin/flat/slight) + 心 heart/emotions → *fear* (← thin/fragile heart; compare 慴 and 懾).
As per 皇# (extend) + 心 heart/emotions → fraught, extended emotions, in the form of anxiety → *be anxious* (compare 遑) → *fear*. Compare also 恇.
恐也。从心皇聲。
春# spring + 心 heart/emotions → *foolish* impulses of young people (in the springtime of their lives). Compare the idea of dullness in 鈍 and in 憃. *Squirm* and *wriggle* are borrowed meanings via 蠢.
亂也。从心春聲。《春秋傳》曰：“王室日惷惷焉。”一曰厚也。
As per 若# (supple) + 心 heart/emotions → provocation strong enough to overcome a supple (= accepting) state of mind → *incite*; *bring about* (← provoke into taking action).
亂也。从心若聲。
An abbreviated form# of 醒 wake up + 心 heart/emotions → *become enlightened*; *wise* (← awaken to reality). Compare 聡.
As per 則# (beside) + 心 heart/emotions → figuratively stand beside another person → *have keen sympathy for* (another); *be sad* (for another).
痛也。从心則聲。
As per 扁# (spread, but remain in contact) + 心 heart/emotions → idea that spreads through the heart/mind but remains within → *narrow-minded*. Compare 褊.
